tasks.title: Conversation #47
tasks.transcript:
Man: Did you manage to fix the issue with your computer?
Woman: I did. It turned out to be a software problem.
Man: Great. What did you do to resolve it?
Woman: I updated the operating system, and now everything is working fine.
Man: It’s always a relief when it’s something simple and not hardware-related.
Woman: Absolutely. My manager told me his computer suddenly powered off last month; it turned out to be a hardware issue, and he had to buy a new computer.

questions.stem: What problem did the woman have with her computer?
questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问女士的电脑出了什么问题，属于细节理解题，需抓住女士对故障原因的直接说明。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 女士明确说“It turned out to be a software problem”，而非硬件问题。 选项B：正确。 女士直接说明问题是软件问题（a software problem）。 选项C：错误。 对话中没有提到网络问题，属于无中生有。 选项D：错误。 女士的电脑问题已通过更新操作系统解决，并非电源问题，属于无关干扰。

questions.stem: Why does the woman mention her manager?

options.A: To explain why she needed her computer urgently
options.B: To indicate that hardware issues can be particularly problematic
options.C: To provide details about how she solved a problem
options.D: To describe the benefits of a new operating system

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问女士为什么提到她的经理，属于组织结构题，需结合上下文理解她举例的用意。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 女士没有提到她急需使用电脑，属于无中生有。 选项B：正确。 男士说“It's always a relief when it's something simple and not hardware-related”，女士回应“Absolutely”，然后举了经理电脑因硬件问题而不得不买新电脑的例子，以此说明硬件问题确实更麻烦、更严重。 选项C：错误。 女士解决自己电脑问题的方法是更新操作系统，经理的例子与她自己如何解决问题无关。 选项D：错误。 女士提到经理是为了对比硬件问题和软件问题的后果，而非描述新操作系统的好处。
